fieldAuthorityOrder: 1. UCBA governs everything (contractual obligations, timing, statuses, agent conduct)
2. REBNY RLS rules + RLS fields (permissions, timing, statuses, mapping, IDs, dissemination)
3. RLS overrides Cotality/IDX — if RLS rule/field exists, it overrides Cotality/IDX schema or vendor defaults
4. Cotality/IDX fills gaps — if no RLS rule/field exists, use Cotality definitions for naming/types/enums
5. INTERNAL-ONLY — if neither RLS nor Cotality/IDX governs, must not affect public display eligibility
6. Fail closed — any uncertainty or missing permission data defaults to NON-DISPLAY

LandAssessedValue.description: Assessed value of the land only.

LandLeaseAmount.description: When the land is not included in the sale, but is leased, the amount of the lease. This is the Space Rent for Mobile homes in a Park.

LandLeaseAmountFrequency.description: When the land is not included in the sale, but is leased, the frequency the Land Lease Fee is paid.

LandLeaseExpirationDate.description: When the land is not included in the sale, but is leased, the expiration date of the Land Lease.

LandLeaseYN.description: The land is not included in the sale and a lease exists.

LandmarkStatusYN.description: Indicates whether a property has been designated landmark status by the government. Having some sort of historic, artistic, or aesthetic value.

Latitude.description: The geographic latitude of some reference point on the property, specified in degrees and decimal parts. Positive numbers must not include the plus symbol.

LaundryFeatures.description: Add this pick list of features and locations where the laundry is located in the property being sold/leased. Refer to BuildingLaundryFeatures for building specific details.

LeaseRenewalOptionYN.description: Indicates whether or not there is an option to renew the lease for the listing.

LeaseType.description: The lease type. Options are Stabilized lease and Non-stabilized lease.

LegalRoomsTotal.description: The number of legal rooms in the building.

Levels.description: The number of levels in the property being sold/leased. For example, One Level, Two Levels, Three or More Levels, Multi/Split, Loft. A discreet horizontal plane of interior living space (excluding basements).

LicensesExpense.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

ListAgentDirectPhone.description: North American 10 digit phone numbers should be in the format of ###-###-#### (separated by hyphens). Other conventions should use the common local standard. International numbers should be preceded by a plus symbol.

ListAgentEmail.description: The email address of the Listing Agent.

ListAgentFullName.description: The full name of the list agent as registered with DOS Licensing

ListAgentHasOwnershipInterestYN.description: Indicates if list agent or list broker have ownership interest of the listing.

ListAgentKeyNumeric.description: Unique identifier of the List Agent. This is the foreign key that relates to the Member resource MemberKeyNumeric

ListAgentMlsId.description: The local, well-known identifier for the member. This value may not be unique, specifically in the case of aggregation systems, this value should be the identifier from the original system.

ListAgentNickname.description: The Alternate name used by the List Agent

ListAgentStateLicense.description: The license of the listing agent. Separate multiple licenses with a comma and space.

ListAgentURL.description: The website URL of the listing agent.

ListingAgreement.description: The nature of the agreement between the seller and the listing agent. Examples are Exclusive Agency, Open Listing, CoExclusive, etc. Please note: Per UCBA, RLS comprises of all exclusive listings. Please reference the UCBA for further details.

ListingContractDate.description: The effective date of the agreement between the seller landlord and the seller's broker. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the RLS.   This date is not editable once submitted.

ListingID.description: The local, well-known identifier for the Listing. This value may not be unique, specifically in the case of aggregation systems, this value should be the identifier from the original system.

ListingIssues.description: This field specifies an issue with the listing that requires restrictions and/or corrections

ListingKeyNumeric.description: The unique identifier for the listing.

ListingSocialMediaURL.description: The URL for social media related to this listing.

ListingTerms.description: Terms of the listing such as Lien Release, Subject to Court Approval or Owner Will Carry. Also may include options that describe the financing terms that are acceptable to the seller, i.e. cash, assumable, FHA loan, etc.

ListingURL.description: Provides a link to the specific listing on a brokerage website, agent website or other public-facing source.

ListOfficeIDXParticipationYN.description: Does the List Office/Broker participate in IDX? True value allows the listing to be sent to an IDX (provided that the list office participates in IDX). This is generated from the IDXOfficeParticipationYN attribute in Member resource and managed through the REBNY membership directory.

ListOfficeKeyNumeric.description: Unique identifier of the List Office. This is the foreign key that relates to the Office resource OfficeKeyNumeric

ListOfficeMlsId.description: The local, well-known identifier. This value may not be unique, specifically in the case of aggregation systems, this value should be the identifier from the original system.

ListOfficeName.description: The legal name of the brokerage representing the seller.

ListOfficePhone.description: North American 10 digit phone numbers should be in the format of ###-###-#### (separated by hyphens). Other conventions should use the common local standard. International numbers should be preceded by a plus symbol.

ListOfficeURL.description: The website URL for the listing office.

ListPrice.description: The current price of the property as determined by the seller/landlord. For auctions this is the minimum or reserve price. For rent/leasing, it must reflect the the gross monthly rent/lease for the listing (not net-effective rent).

ListTeamKeyNumeric.description: Unique identifier of the List Team. This is the foreign key that relates to the Team resource TeamKeyNumeric

ListTeamMlsId.description: The local, well-known identifier. This value may not be unique, specifically in the case of aggregation systems, this value should be the identifier from the original system.

ListTeamName.description: The name of the team representing the seller/landlord

LivingArea.description: The total livable area within the structure of the unit or property in which it is for sale or lease.

LivingAreaSource.description: The source of the measurements. This is a pick list of options showing the source of the measurement (e.g., Agent, Assessor, Estimate).

LivingAreaUnits.description: A pick list of the unit of measurement for the area. i.e. Square Feet, Square Meters, Acres, etc.

Longitude.description: The geographic longitude of some reference point on the property, specified in degrees and decimal parts. Positive numbers must not include the plus symbol.

LotFeatures.description: A list of features or description of the lot included in the sale/lease.

LotSizeArea.description: The total area of the lot. See Lot Size Units for the units of measurement (Square Feet, Square Meters, Acres, etc.).

LotSizeDimensions.description: The dimensions of the lot minimally represented as length and width (i.e. 250 x 180) or a measurement of all sides of the polygon representing the property lines of the property. i.e. 30 x 50 x 120 x 60 x 22.

LotSizeSource.description: The source of the measurements. This may be a pick list of options showing the source of the measurement. i.e. Agent, Assessor, Estimate, etc.

LotSizeUnits.description: A pick list of the unit of measurement for the area. i.e. Square Feet, Square Meters, Acres, etc.

MaintenanceExpense.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

MajorChangeTimestamp.description: Timestamp of the last major change on the listing (see also MajorChangeType).

MajorChangeType.description: Description of the last major change on the listing, i.e. “price reduction”, “back on market”, etc. May be used to display on a summary view of listing results to quickly identify listings that have had major changes recently.

ManagerExpense.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations. This is for an individual manager. Use ProfessionalManagementExpense for a management company.

ManagingAgencyListingYN.description: This field distinguishes between a listing that is handled directly by an owner or an owner’s Managing Agency (having signed up with REBNY), versus a listing that is handled through a standard real estate brokerage company.

MatrixTesting.description: Flag to identify whether it is a test listing submitted. This will be automatically flagged for the LMPs as they are currently testing.  This flag will not be available once migrated to production

MaximumFinancingAmount.description: The maximum amount a lender will finance for the listing, expressed as an amount.

MaximumFinancingPercent.description: The maximum amount a lender will finance for the listing, expressed as a percentage of the sale price.

MaximumFinancingRemarks.description: Text description of the maximum allowed financing.

MaxLeaseMonths.description: The maximum length of the lease expressed as a number of months.

MinLeaseMonths.description: The minimum length of the lease expressed as a number of months.

MlsMajorChangeType.description: Description of the last MLS status major change on the listing, i.e. “price reduction”, “back on market”, etc. May be used to display on a summary view of listing results to quickly identify listings that have had major changes recently.

MlsStatus.description: RLS Status. Each MlsStatus maps to a single StandardStatus. Multiple MlsStatus may map to a single StandardStatus.

ModificationTimestamp.description: The transactional timestamp automatically recorded by the RLS system representing the date/time the listing was last modified.

MoveInCosts.description: Specific fees not included in the base rent or deposit that apply to the listing (e.g., application fees, move-in fees).

MoveInCostsComments.description: Comments or clarifications regarding the additional listing fees.Comments or clarifications regarding the Move In Costs.

MoveInCostsAmountTotal.description: The total monetary value of all Move In Costs associated with the listing.

NetMonthlyRent.description: The lease monthly amount a lessee pays on average per month of a lease period, a mathematical calculation that takes into account free months on the lease as if they'd been paid for.

NetOperatingIncome.description: Net operating income is the revenue from a property after operating expenses have been deducted, but before deducting income taxes and financing expenses (interest and Principal Payments). For example, Gross Income - Operating Expenses = Net Operating Income (NOI).

NewConstructionYN.description: Indicates whether or not the property is newly constructed and has not been previously occupied.

NewDevelopmentYN.description: Indicates whether or not the property with a structure(s) that is(are) newly constructed, converted or both selling individual units.

NewlyConvertedUnitYN.description: Indicate whether the unit was newly converted from rental or any other property type to condo/coop.

NewTaxesExpense.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

NumberOfBuildings.description: Total number of separate buildings on the premise.

NumberOfProfessionalUnitsTotal.description: Total number of professional units in building.

NumberOfRetailUnits.description: Total number of retail units in building.

NumberOfSeparateElectricMeters.description: Total number of separate meters included/part of the listing.

NumberOfSeparateGasMeters.description: Total number of separate meters  included/part of the listing.

NumberOfSeparateWaterMeters.description: Total number of separate meters  included/part of the listing.

NumberOfShares.description: The number of shares allocated to the specific listing.

NumberOfUnitsInCommunity.description: The total number of units in the building, complex or community. This is not the number of units being sold, but rather the size of the community in which the dwelling being sold is located.

NumberOfUnitsTotal.description: Total number of residential units included in the property, occupied or unoccupied.

NumberOfUnitsVacant.description: The number of units currently vacant.

OccupantType.description: A field that describes the type of occupant, i.e. Owner, Tenant, Vacant.

OffMarketDate.description: The date the listing was taken off market in the Source System. Where possible, this date is reflective of the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the RLS.

OffMarketTimestamp.description: The transactional timestamp automatically recorded by the MLS system representing the most recent date/time the listing's status was set to and off market status (not Active or Backup)

OnMarketDate.description: The date the listing was placed on market in the Source System. Where possible, this date is reflective of the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the RLS.

OnMarketTimestamp.description: The transactional timestamp automatically recorded by the MLS system representing the most recent date/time the listing's status was set to Active or Backup. This also includes initial input of the listing to Active/Backup or from a draft or approval status to Active/Backup.

OpenHouseCount.description: Total count of open house rows

OpenHousePublicCount.description: Total count of open house rows where OpenHouseType is public

OpenHousePublicUpcoming.description: Total count of open house rows where OpenHouse Type is public and Open House Start Time is in the future

OpenHouseUpcoming.description: Total count of open house rows where OpenHouseStartTime is in the future

OpenParkingSpaces.description: The number of open or uncovered parking spaces included in the sale.

OpenParkingYN.description: Indicates whether that any parking spaces associated with the property are not covered by a roof.

OperatingExpense.description: The costs associated with the operation and maintenance of an income-producing property.

OriginalDetailYN.description: Indicates whether the building still have the original detail.

OriginalEntryTimestamp.description: The transactional timestamp automatically recorded by the RLS system representing the date/time the listing was entered and made visible to members of the RLS.

OriginalListPrice.description: The initial list price that was entered into the system or advertised. This differs to PreviousListPrice which is autogenerated by the RLS.

OtherEquipment.description: A list of other equipment that will be included in the listing that is for sale/lease.

OtherExpense.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

OtherExpenseRemarks.description: Description of other expenses incurred on the property.

OtherStructures.description: A list of structures other than the main dwelling. For example, Guest House, Barn, Shed, etc.

OwnerPays.description: A list of expenses for the property paid for by the owner/landlord as opposed to the tenant (e.g. Water, Trash, Electric). The attribute should be used for listings that are being leased by individual owners or listings with less than 5 units.  Please refer to attributes such as AssociationAmenities

OwnerPaysPlusConcessionsYN.description: True means owner will pay commission portion and provide concession. False means owner will not provide both.

OwnerPaysRemarks.description: Describes the detail of what the owner/landlord will pay opposed to the tenant.

ParcelNumber.description: A number used to uniquely identify a parcel or lot. This number is typically issued by the county or county assessor. The AP number format varies from county to county. It is recommended that all Parcel Numbers be transmitted without dashes or hyphens.

ParkingFeatures.description: A list of features or description of the parking included in the sale/lease.

ParkingTotal.description: The total number of parking spaces included in the sale or lease.

PatioAndPorchFeatures.description: A list of features or description of the patio or porch included in the sale/lease.

PendingTimestamp.description: The transactional timestamp automatically recorded by the RLS system representing the most recent date/time the listing's status was set to Pending.

PercentOfCommonElements.description: For condominiums, ownership of common elements expressed as a percentage. Value entered should be on 0-100 scale, not fractional.

Permissions.description: The level of access permission for the listing. Only listings marked Private (Participant's Only Listing) will be accessible.

PestControlExpense.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

PetDepositFee.description: If pets allowed, the fee required for deposit.

PetsAllowed.description: Indicates whether or not pets are allowed for the specific listing/unit.  For building specific policy, please refer to BuildingPetsAllowed field.

PetsAllowedComments.description: Any comments or additional information to expand on the PetsAllowed attribute.

PhotosChangeTimestamp.description: System generated timestamp of when the last update or change to the photos for this listing was made.

PhotosCount.description: The total number of pictures or photos included with the listing.

PoolExpense.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

PoolFeatures.description: A list of features or description of the pool on the property.

Possession.description: A list defining when possession will occur. i.e. COE, COE+1, etc.

PossibleUse.description: A list of the type(s) of possible or best uses of the property. Probable use gives a good indication of what the best use or potential use of the property could be (e.g., Residential, Recreational, Commercial, Retail).

PostalCity.description: The official city per the U.S. Postal Service (USPS), which may be different from the recorded city. For example "Astoria, NY", PostalCity = Astoria.

PostalCode.description: The postal code portion of a street or mailing address.

PostalCodePlus4.description: The postal code + 4 portion of a street or mailing address.

PreviousListPrice.description: The most recent previous ListPrice of the listing.

PreviousStatus.description: The most recent previous Status of the listing.

PriceChangeTimestamp.description: The transactional timestamp automatically recorded by the RLS system representing the date/time the listing's price was last changed.

PrivateOutdoorSpaceRemarks.description: Describes in detail the type of private outdoor space available including the dimensions of any outdoor spaces.

PrivateOutdoorSpaceSize.description: Indicates the estimated size of the private outdoor space that is available with the listing.

PrivateRemarks.description: The PrivateRemarks is to be used to share key details across the community that are to be seen only by RLS Participants.

ProfessionalManagementExpense.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations. This is for a management company. Use ManagerExpense for a individual manager.

PropertyCondition.description: A listing describing the condition of the listing that is for sale/lease. All items in the definition must be met. This attribute is only permitted for agent view ONLY. This cannot be shared or displayed to any consumer/clients. Disclaimer must be conspicuously present on the page where the Property

PropertySubType.description: A list of types of residential properties of the listing and not to describe the property that the listing may reside.

PropertyType.description: A list of types of properties such as Residential Sale or Residential Lease. This attribute will classify whether this is a Sale vs Lease. Any sales should be classified as either Residential Sale; Any leases should be classified as Residential Lease.

PublicRemarks.description: Text remarks that may be displayed to the public. This information is intended to be visible online and distributed. This is typically information that describes the selling points of the listing that is for sale/lease. Please refer to the UCBA for requirements of what is permitted and not permitted

PurchaseContractDate.description: This is the date of when the offer was accepted and contract was fully executed. This contract date should match what is recorded under public records. This is not to be confused with the CloseDate which is a separate attribute.

RentingAllowedYN.description: Indicates whether or not tenant is permitted to rent/sublet the unit/property

RoofRightsYN.description: Indicating whether or not the unit/property have permission to access the building roof.

RoomCount.description: Matrix field that calculates the total number of room rows

RoomsTotal.description: The total number of rooms included in the property listing for sale or lease. For clarification on what constitutes a room, please refer to the NYC Administrative Code.

SecurityFeatures.description: A list describing the security features on the property.

SeniorCommunityYN.description: Indicates whether or not a community is a senior community.

ShowingContactName.description: The name of the contact for the showing of the listed property.

ShowingContactPhone.description: The extension of the given phone number (if applicable).

ShowingContactType.description: The type of contact for the showing. i.e. Agent, Broker, Seller.

ShowingDays.description: The days of the week that the property is available for showing. i.e. Sundays, Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays, Fridays, Saturdays

ShowingEndTime.description: From the days selected in the ShowingDays field, the end time that the property is available for showing.

ShowingInstructions.description: Remarks that detail the seller's instructions for showing the subject property. Showing instructions may include: contact information, showing times, notice required or other information. These remarks are privileged and are not for public viewing.

ShowingStartTime.description: From the days selected in the ShowingDays field, the start time that the property is available for showing.

SizeDimensions.description: The dimensions of the building minimally represented as length and width (i.e. 250 x 180) or a measurement of all sides of the polygon representing the property. i.e. 30 x 50 x 120 x 60 x 22

SourceSystemKey.description: A unique identifier for this record from the immediate source. This is a string that can include URI or other forms. Alternatively use the ListingKeyNumeric for a numeric only key field. This is the local key of the system. When records are received from other systems, a local key is commonly applie

SourceSystemModificationTimestamp.description: The transactional timestamp automatically recorded by the source system representing the date/time the listing was last modified at the source.

SourceSystemName.description: The name of the immediate record provider. The system from which the record was directly received. LMP's Company Name

SpaFeatures.description: A list of features or description of the spa included in the sale/lease.

SpaYN.description: Indicate whether or not there is a hot tub in the unit or part of the listing that is for sale/lease.

SpecialAssessmentExpirationDateTime.description: The date when the special assessment expires

SpecialListingConditions.description: A list of options that describe the type of sale. i.e. Standard, REO, Short Sale, Probate, Auction, NOD, etc., at the time of listing. This includes whether the applicant is required for board approval.

SponsorUnitYN.description: A unit offered by the developer/sponsor/owner of the building, usually indicating that the unit is being sold for the first time.  SPONSOR UNIT MUST BE PURSUANT TO AN OFFERING PLAN (AND OR FILED AMENDMENT) AS APPROVED BY THE ATTORNEY GENERAL OF THE STATE OF NY.

StandardStatus.description: The status of the listing as it reflects the state of the contract between the listing agent and seller, or an agreement with a buyer (e.g.Incomplete, Active, Active Under Contract, Canceled, Closed, Expired, Pending, Withdrawn). This is a single-select field.

StateOrProvince.description: Text field containing the accepted postal abbreviation for the state or province. RLS database contains listing in the 5 Boroughs of NYC therefore all listings should indicate New York for this attribute.

StatusChangeTimestamp.description: The transactional timestamp automatically recorded by the RLS system representing the date/time the listing's status was last changed.

Stories.description: The number of floors in the property being listed for sale or lease.

StoriesTotal.description: The total number of floors in the building. In the case of multi-dwelling structures, this is the entire structure and not the individual dwelling being sold.

StreetDirPrefix.description: The direction indicator that precedes the listed property's street name.

StreetDirSuffix.description: The direction indicator that follows a listed property's street address.

StreetName.description: The street name portion of a listed property's street address.

StreetNumber.description: The street number portion of a listed property's street address. In some areas the street number may contain non-numeric characters. This field can also contain extensions and modifiers to the street number, such as "1/2" or "-B". This street number field should not include Prefixes, Direction or Su

StreetNumberNumeric.description: The integer portion of the street number.

StreetSuffix.description: The suffix portion of a listed property's street address.

StructureType.description: The type of structure that the property completely or partially encompasses. For example: House are the overall sold or leased as a whole. Multi Family or Mixed-Use may be sold/leased in whole, but are often sold or leased by units. This field is the type of structure as opposed to style, which is u

SuperExpense.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations. This is for superintendent.

SuppliesExpense.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

SyndicateYN._trestleNote: UCBA references SyndicateYN as boolean. Trestle field is SyndicateTo (portal selection). Kept for backward compatibility with internal validation logic.
SyndicateYN.description: Indicates whether a listing can be syndicated to approved data license portals. The Principal Broker, on behalf of the firm, are permitted to select the vendors they wish to opt-in to through the Trestle platform.

TaxAbatementExpirationYear.description: Indicate the year the tax abatement expires

TaxAbatementYN.description: Indicate whether there is a tax abatement

TaxAnnualAmount.description: The annual property tax amount as of the last assessment made by the taxing authority for the building.

TaxBlock.description: A type of legal description for land in developed areas where streets or other rights-of-ways delineate large parcels of land referred to as divided into lots on which homes or other types of developments are built. An example would read "Lot 12 of Block 45 of Tract 3002 of the City of San Dunes, De

TaxDeductionAmount.description: The amount of tax deduction an owner can claim for the property.

TaxDeductionPercent.description: The amount of tax deduction an owner can claim for the property, expressed as a percentage of the sale price.

TaxDeductionRemarks.description: Remarks relating to the amount of tax deduction an owner can claim for the property.

TaxLot.description: Specific to the Unit, if different from the whole property/building. For example condominiums in NYC typically have their own designated lot number per unit.  A type of legal description for land in developed areas where streets or other rights-of-ways delineate large parcels of land referred to as

TaxMonthlyAmount.description: The monthly amount of tax for condos. Please refer to Building Resource>TaxAnnualAmount for Townhouse, Single Homes, or Building, Lots.

TotalDocumentsCount.description: Total Count of all documents including public and private documents

TotalMonthlyMaintPlusTax.description: Monthly Tax Amount + Monthly maintenance or common charges.

TotalPhotosCount.description: Total Count of all photos including public and private photos

TransferredFromKey.description: The previous LMP unique identifier for this record prior to the transfer.

TransferredFromSystemName.description: The previous system from which the record was directly received. LMP's Company Name

TransferredToSystemName.description: The name of the new source system (LMP) after the transfer. This should match with the Sourcey System Name after the listing have been claimed

TrashExpense.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

UnitCount.description: Count of all rows for Units Subtable - used for Residential Income

UnitLine.description: Physical line of the property's unit.

UnitNumber.description: Text field containing the number or portion of a larger building or complex. Unit Number should appear following the street suffix or, if it exists, the street suffix direction, in the street address. Examples are: "APT G", "55", etc.

UnitTypes.description: A collection of types of units included in the income (multifamily) property. The collection includes a type, beds, baths and other aspects of the type of unit behind described.

UnitTypeType.description: This field is a list of the types used in the Unit Type repeating elements. The type is a list of possible unit types (i.e., 1 Bedroom, 2 Bedroom, 3 Bedroom, Studio, Loft, etc.). Each selected item is expected to appear as the type in the related UnitType fields in a flattened implementation. The fa

UnitsFurnished.description: Total Calculated field of unit rows that are furnished. Are the units furnished? i.e. All Units, Varies By Unit, None.

UnParsedAddress.description: The UnparsedAddress is a text representation of the address. Includes Street Number, Street Dir Prefix, Street Name, Street Dir Suffix, Street Suffix. DO NOT INCLUDE UNIT NUMBER in the UnparsedAddress.

VideosChangeTimestamp.description: System generated timestamp of when the last update or change to the videos for this listing was made.

VideosCount.description: The total number of videos or virtual tours included with the listing.

View.description: For unit, a view as seen from the listed unit. For building sale/lease, a view as seen from the property.

ViewRemarks.description: Detail description of the view as seen from the listed sale/lease.

ViewYN.description: The listed for sale/lease has a view.

VirtualTourURLBranded.description: A text field that holds the URL for an branded virtual tour of the property.

VirtualTourURLUnbranded.description: A text field that holds the URL for an unbranded virtual tour of the property.

VirtualTourURLUnbranded2.description: A text field that holds the URL for a 2nd unbranded virtual tour of the property.

VirtualTourURLUnbranded3.description: A text field that holds the URL for a 3rd unbranded virtual tour of the property.

WaterfrontYN.description: The property is on the waterfront.

WaterSewerExpense.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

WindowFeatures.description: A list of features or description of the windows included in the sale/lease.

WithdrawnDate.description: Date the listing was withdrawn from the market in the Source System. This is not when a listing contract was cancelled or closed, but a withdrawal from the market while the contract between the seller and listing agent is still in effect and an offer has not been accepted. This is the date entered b

WorkmansCompensationExpense.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

YearBuilt.description: The year that an occupancy permit is first granted for the house or other local measure of initial habitability of the build. The type definition permits an empty value with an attribute noting that it is an unknown date or that the building is new construction. While constraints have not been appli

YearRenovated.description: The year the unit was renovated.

ZoningDescription.description: A list of descriptions of the zoning of the property. The zoning codes are often non-descriptive and variant. Zoning Description is a more descriptive form of the zoning for the property, i.e. Agricultural, Residential, Rezone Possible, etc. Specific zone codes must be added to the Zoning field.
